title: Source-alignment follow-up — targeted Persian revisions
description: A focused follow-up on the 48 historical alignment entries not revised in Increment 53. The original gp32 English script was checked directly against the existing Persian text. Eight targeted revisions are proposed; ambiguous event-boundary cases are retained without speculative rewriting. Independent native-Persian sign-off remains pending.
style_guide: Narration uses contemporary literary-conversational Persian: intimate, restrained, natural, and never uniformly formal or slang-heavy.
Dialogue remains spoken and character-specific; preserve hesitation, pauses, and unfinished phrases.
Preserve source meaning and emotional understatement; do not add explanations or actions not present in the English.
Correct translationese, semantic drift, awkward collocations, and lost nuances without over-editing faithful existing Persian.

review_scope.method: The remaining 48 historical alignment entries were compared with the English gp32 event text and their active Persian source in the earlier recovery layer. Eight clear semantic or idiomatic improvements are proposed. Other entries were left unchanged where the Persian was already adequate or where the issue concerned uncertain event boundaries rather than a demonstrable translation error.
review_scope.source: gp32 / Insani 2005 English localization, represented by the repository's story-gp32.json events
